propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria as plain bullets instead of checkboxes, making their criteria invisible to _count_ac_items counting and the P1 blocking floor
Success Criteria bullets must be converted to Acceptance Criteria checklist items (- [ ]) so they are individually checkable and can carry the [operator-attested] tag
The migration script must rewrite tickets through rebar.edit_ticket as auditable events, merge existing SC blocks into AC blocks, and remove the SC heading entirely
Closed tickets are migrated by default; open/in_progress tickets require an explicit flag to avoid silently invalidating in-flight plan-review attestations
All migrated tickets must return _count_ac_items >= 1 and have no remaining Success Criteria headings after migration
